text:
Sam Walker: Quick heads up — discovered a regression in serving-runtime v1.3.2: a tokenization edge case can cause 502s for very long prompts (>8k tokens). Patch branch: fix/tokenize-guard. Requesting expedited approval to deploy a canary now and promote to prod within tonight's 20:00-21:00 change window if green.

DeployBot: CI pipeline status: unit ✅ (98%), integration ✅, smoke tests flaky 1/12. Built image: redwood/runtime:v1.3.2-hotfix1. Canary ready in eu-west-1. Suggested command: `/deploy canary redwood/runtime:v1.3.2-hotfix1 --region eu-west-1 --weight 1%`

Priya Patel: Need explicit rollback plan + confirmation we pin model versions. If error_rate > 1% we revert to redwood/runtime:v1.3.2. Who owns rollback? @Alex Chen?

Alex Chen: I can own rollback. No DB/migration changes. We'll pin only the runtime. Rollout config I'll use:```yaml
rollout:
  initial_weight: 1%
  ramp: 1% -> 20%
  canary_duration: 15m
  health_check: 200
  automatic_rollback_on_error_rate: 1%
  fallback_image: redwood/runtime:v1.3.2
```

Maria Gomez: What's the SLO impact and alert thresholds? If 502 spikes, automatic rollback after 3 consecutive 1min windows > threshold? Also add an alert to paging channel.

DeployBot: Canary deployed at 1% in eu-west-1. Telemetry (last 10m): error_rate=0.2%, p95_latency +3ms. Traces indicate tokenization-guard path executed for failed cases. Starting 15m canary timer now.

Liam O'Neill: Approving expedited canary and conditional prod promotion for tonight's window. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Security sign-off: no secret or policy changes, approving expedited. :white_check_mark:

Sam Walker: OK initiating staged rollout after canary window if metrics remain stable. I'll update release notes and bump patch. Prod target tag: redwood/runtime:v1.3.2-hotfix1

DeployBot: Prod rollout started at 1% across regions at 1749802460, ramping to 20% over 30m. Monitoring bound to rollout: observability.alerts/rollout. Use `/rollback redwood/runtime:v1.3.2` to revert.

Alex Chen: If we need full rollback I'll execute and open a postmortem. For now watching dashboards.

Maria Gomez: I'll add a short note to release notes and docs: description, affected endpoints (/generate, /chat), mitigation, and owner contacts.

Sam Walker: Thanks everyone. Will ping when we finish the 30m ramp.
